transfer.stem: Which plan follows the correspondence instructions?
transfer.passage:
Checking the club correspondence
Our club was arranging a visit. “Leave a message if nobody answers” gave a condition for leaving a message; it did not confirm that nobody had answered or that a message had already been left. We were told to send the route map as an email attachment. Mentioning the map in the email body would not attach the file, and an instruction to send it was not proof that it had been sent.
The mail arrived just before lunch. That gave the order and a short interval, not an exact clock time. A pupil said, “I will post the card on my way home.” The pupil intended to mail the card; this was not a report of an online post or completed delivery.
In a separate envelope-front exercise, we moved a schematic stamp to the top right corner. That practised position; it did not establish real postage or delivery. The address was to be written clearly on the envelope, not only on a separate note. Here address meant a postal address, not a speech.
We also kept a specific rule: never publish a home address in a public chat. We did not turn it into a ban on every kind of message or ask anyone to enter a real address. Finally, checking the postcode came before sending the parcel. The instruction did not supply a postcode or prove that one had already been checked.

options.text: The route map should be an attachment; the stamp goes at the top right; the postcode is checked before sending.
Mentioning the route map in the body is enough; the stamp goes at the top right; the postcode is checked before sending.
The route map should be an attachment; the stamp goes at the top left; the postcode is checked before sending.
The route map should be an attachment; the stamp goes at the top right; the postcode is checked after sending.

answer.display: The route map should be an attachment; the stamp goes at the top right; the postcode is checked before sending.

steps.text: as an attachment要求附上文件；top right同时看上、右。
steps.reason: 正文提到不能代替附件；右上不能换成左上。

steps.text: before sending要求先核对，再寄出。
steps.reason: 指示给出先后顺序，没有确认已经寄出或邮编已经正确。
